label: Долго
description: A 10-sentence usage card for долго (for a long time; long).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Duration of an action. 'Долго' means for a long time, measuring the length of the walk. It pairs naturally with imperfective verbs that describe an extended process.
Strategic focus: Taking so long. In this elliptical question 'так долго' means taking such a long time, with a tone of impatience. The verb is left out but understood.
Strategic focus: Too long with a command. Modified by 'слишком' the adverb 'долго' means too long, urging against overthinking. With the imperative it advises a quicker decision.
Strategic focus: How long. The question 'как долго' asks about the duration of the film. It seeks a measure of length in time.

Strategic focus: For a long time with negation. Here 'долго не мог' means could not for a long time, stretching the failed attempt over an extended span. The adverb measures how long the inability lasted.
Strategic focus: Excessive duration. 'Слишком долго' marks the delivery as taking unacceptably long. The imperfective шло depicts the drawn-out journey of the letter.

Strategic focus: Long in a fairy-tale formula. The set ending 'долго и счастливо' means happily ever after, with 'долго' measuring the length of the happy life. It is the classic close of a Russian tale.
Strategic focus: Long in a future question. With будешь the adverb 'долго' asks about an expected length of stay. It inquires how long the future presence will last.
Strategic focus: Long in an impersonal frame. 'Долго' measures the drawn-out explaining in a subjectless construction where 'мне' is the dative recipient. It stresses how lengthy the process felt.

Strategic focus: For a long time with negation. The pairing 'долго не действовало' means did not work for a long time, measuring the stretch before any effect. The imperfective marks the prolonged ineffectiveness.
